latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of text-to-video-diffusion:

- Generate 1080p AI-powered videos directly from text prompts.
- Simple workflow: enter a descriptive sentence, get a video in 1–3 minutes—no manual editing needed.
- Automated backend setup, including free token retrieval (100 credits for 7 days) and session management.
- Supports file uploads, timeline edits, credits checking, and one-click export (MP4, various formats and tracks).
- User input intelligently routed to actions (generate, upload, export, check balance, etc.) using keyword/intent analysis.
- Cloud rendering with detailed API response handling and clear error messages for common issues.
